Delegatron 9000 is a Grok Bot that runs your other bots. Give it a goal and it splits the work across the bots you already have, shows you the plan to approve, sends each bot its task, and follows up until it's done. https://t.co/JBYRylJxbK https://t.co/2R7Fu83oYE pic.twitter.com/SoHEzPGC7T

— Pitchfork & Torch ♞ (@SuddenlyJon) October 2, 2026
